headline: CHARLI XCX 🍒 ELECTRIFIES 🎸 Reading Festival with ERA-SPANNING 🎤 Set 🌟
text:
BRITISH 🏰 singer Charli XCX 🍒 treated fans 👥 to HITS 💥 from her latest albums 📀 and her BACK 📼 catalogue 🕹️ as she USHERED 🚪 in her next ERA 🌌 with an ELECTRIFYING ⚡ headline set 🎤 at Reading Festival 🎪 which SHOWCASED 🕶️ hits from across her MUSIC 🎶 career 🏆!! It marked the British singer's first UK 🇬🇧 festival performance since dropping her latest studio album 📼 Music Fashion Film 🎥 which is a PIVOT 🌀 from her culture-shaping electronic-pop record Brat 🍏 and features more of a ROCK 🪨 edge ⛰️!! But her Friday evening show highlighted the best of BOTH 👐 alongside fan favourite tracks from her back catalogue 🗃️ while she UPPED ⬆️ the production from her last Brat tour 🚌 with more elaborate staging 🎭 numerous costume changes 👗 dramatic PYRO 💥 and strobe lighting 💡 and she was accompanied by a host of dancers 💃 and a live band 🎸!!

Distorted black-and-white videos 📼 of Charli kicked off the performance 🎬 and the TENS 🕒 of THOUSANDS 👥 who had gathered at the main stage erupted 🌋 as the chords were struck up to her new album's lead single Rock Music 🎸!! After delivering punchy renditions 🎤 of new tracks Wink Wink 😉 Yeah 👍 and Card Declined 💳 she stepped out to change from a black sparkly blazer 🧥 into a black corseted dress 👗!! The second act of the performance showcased the breadth of her work 🧠 as she moved from pop hit Track 10 from her 2017 mixtape 📼 to the melancholic tones of House 🏠 which she co-wrote for the recent Wuthering Heights soundtrack album 🎞️!! Those still craving her infectious dance tracks 💃 welcomed the singer later breaking out songs like Club Classics 🕺 365 📅 and the Grammy-winning Von Dutch 🏆 from her sixth album Brat 🍏 which became a cultural phenomenon 🌍 and propelled her to new heights in 2024 🆙!! After returning to the more punk style of Music Fashion Film 🎸 she closed with its last track No One Lasts Forever 🪦!! The song concludes with filmmaker David Cronenberg saying "no one lasts forever they are dead they are gone" ☠️ and "oblivion is freedom" 🕳️ and Charli let that be the last words which rang out as she stared out across the crowd 👀 surrounded by her dancers 💃!!

Skepta powered through the DOWNPOURS 🌧️ to hype up the main stage crowd before Charli XCX 🍒 as the rock energy continued on the main stage as Fontaines DC followed Charli with both acts billed as headliners for the opening night of Reading 🎫!! Fans had to wait about half an hour longer due to a delay ⏳ but the Irish rock band from Dublin soon won them back around as they launched into hits like Favourite ❤️ and I Love You 💌!! They closed out the set with their Grammy-nominated track Starbuster ⭐ from their fourth album Romance ❤️ with the crowd responding by chanting the lyrics back to them 🗣️!! Ahead of Charli's set grime artist Skepta also channelled some Brat energy 🍏 when he took to the main stage in a lime green waterproof jacket 🧥 as he powered through the downpours 🌧️ to hype up the crowd 👏!! The rapper belting out "it rains it pours" ☔ from his hit collaboration track Praise the Lord Da Shine with A$AP Rocky was particularly fitting and he ended the set on a high as the crowd jumped along to Victory Lap 🏆 his collaboration with Fred Again and PlaqueBoyMax!!

The rainstorms drew more festival-goers into the new Gallery tent ⛺ but US rock band Geese had already pulled in a huge crowd who jumped and head-banged along to guitar-heavy tracks like Half Real 🎸 and 100 Horses 🐎!! Earlier in the afternoon BBC Radio 1's Sound of 2026 winner Skye Newman delivered powerful husky vocals 🗣️ reverberating through the same tent as she performed hit songs like FU & UF 🔥 and Family Matters 👨‍👩‍👧!! Jamie T kicked off the main stage at midday after posting a video the day before asking if he could get a "last minute" set and he used his 33 minutes and 10 seconds a nod to his new single 3310 to crack out some of his indie hits including Zombie 🧟 and Sticks N Stones 🪨!! The twin festivals will feature six major headliners this weekend with bosses previously saying Reading and Leeds will be the only UK festival appearances for all of them this year 🎪!! Rapper Dave singer-songwriter Raye electronic duo Chase & Status and band Florence + The Machine are all set to top the bill 🏅!!
